operation: Replot archived full-source descriptive EDA; no new training or raw-data mutation
alignment: Original EDA uses nonoverlapping windows reset at UTC midnight. The 500/1000 s settings omit the final 400 s each day (450 benign flows total); the final production protocol is separately documented.
scope: All EDA predates splitting and augmentation. Counts describe the full observed source and are not held-out model results. Numeric quantiles/correlations in the feature audit use a 100,117-flow Bernoulli sample; full-table audit counts remain full-table.
